# repurpose-engine

Single-source content repurposing engine. Takes a blog post, transcript, or voice-memo transcript and produces platform-native drafts for X, LinkedIn, Reddit, Newsletter, YouTube Shorts, and Instagram.

```bash
python repurpose.py --platform x --content "Your source text here."
python repurpose.py --platform linkedin --content "..." --json
```
